findings.text: The fixture still hard-codes its own omitted contract modules (`SchemaInputs`, `Requirements`, `Interpretation`, `SqlInputs`) as a set literal inside `export`, which `export_bundle` does not omit, so the attack bundles can still differ from the bundles that preparation produces. Fix: put the fixture-only omissions in a named constant with a docstring that says why they differ from `export_bundle`, or build the omitted set exactly as `export_bundle` does (`trusted_imports | {PROTECTED_BASE_MODULE}`).
